# Universe24: the one run

This document stands on the branch engine-5.0-test, the engine 5.0 under test (the Boss's word of the owner, 2026-10-25, 16:3x UTC): main is 4.0, the tree of 0fcc0403d (2026-10-24, 10:12 UTC, the trains and the parameters declared, where Universe24 ran), returned by the owner's word of 2026-10-25 (15:2x UTC); main's documents are 4.0's and are not edited; the four documents are kept on the branch alone, where the generic Node-clock's program continues under test, nothing on it a release. This document is the run's: what Universe24 is, what its one run must show, the gates the owner approved, the chart's verdict on each gate by name, what is open, and the commands that run and read the chart. It is one of the project's four documents (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 10:0x UTC): [docs/HIGHLIGHTS.md](HIGHLIGHTS.md) holds the postulates and the decisions in force, [docs/ALGEBRA.md](ALGEBRA.md) the law, [docs/ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md) the engine, and this one the run. Where a line here points at the law, the law's line governs and no formula is restated. Every number of the chart below is read from the chart's logs (`examples/events/universe24/universe24.clicks.jsonl`, the chart; `universe24.eras.jsonl` and `universe24.nodes.jsonl`, the great clock's looks beside it) through the one reckoner's tables (`readings_clicks.json`) and the folder's `notes.md`; none is typed from memory. The chart read is that of main c60804dc7 (PUSH 37, main 7366816f7; 2,400 ticks of 2026-10-24; the byte check by a second run equal through 1,561, the whole second run waived by the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 00:1x UTC). What does not match nature is named, never hidden; nothing is left open without a name. The clock concepts it uses are defined once, in English, in [CLOCK_WORDS.md](CLOCK_WORDS.md), the section The concepts, defined.

## 1. What Universe24 is

One world, one universe, one Node-clock (the project's postulates in one place, the head of docs/ALGEBRA.md, The postulates, since 2026-10-26). The piece is the universe, the great clock's shape (a cubic lattice wrapped on every axis, a torus), the run's length and, since the owner's approval of 2026-10-25 (ALGEBRA.md, **The setting is a list of settings**), the setting as a list of settings in three forms, `{"universe": ..., "shape": [5, 5, 5], "intervals": 2400, "seed": [...]}`; the chart's file of this document holds the first three ("three things and nothing else" to that approval, kept by name; the engine's loader refuses the key `seed` on this branch, the one src line the item changes). The calibre of the engine's chart is three integers and nothing else, `{"den", "node_clock", "quantum_action"}`: den, Gamma the full rate and T the whole piece's action, nature's constants alone (the law since 2026-10-25 adds the gears' pairs as numbers, no number in the code, and derives G at the load from Gamma, K-S1 of 08:2x UTC GitHub's clock, the key `link_unit` of 06:4x to 08:2x kept by name; the conditions on Gamma, T and den the loader's refusals, **The constants of the universe**, ALGEBRA.md, **The Node-clock**; the engine reads the three, ENGINE.md, section 3); a file naming any other key is refused at load (HIGHLIGHTS.md, the postulates 1, 6 and 8; ALGEBRA.md, **The Node-clock**; **No train is declared: the trains emerge at the click**). The law's line of 2026-10-25 (ALGEBRA.md, **The universe holds the gears' pairs as numbers**) puts the gears' pairs [num, den] in the calibre beside the three as constants read once at the load, numbers and no names; the engine of this branch and the chart below read the three integers and derive den's circle at the load (ENGINE.md, sections 2 and 3). The standing rule of the method (the owner's word of that day): the former way is forbidden, trains declared by name, pairs fitted to the great clock or to nature's ratios, holders and reads typed in; what the engine shows is derived, in order, two blind hands, the cold read, the owner's word on the sentence, the code from the agreed derivation, each property with its small test. The loader sets the settings (light at one quantum on every Node-clock of the torus but the origin, the hole) and reads the three integers and the shape; after that everything happens by itself at the Node-clocks: every Node-clock does Rule3 and the same fixed acts from what it reads over one Mesh, and writes a line, a click, where it reads a whole quantum (ALGEBRA.md, **The Node-clock**; **The great clock reads itself**; **The bound bob's click is the Node-clock's act**). No bob, no detector, no train, no window and no rate is declared; the fittings, the bobs, the trains, the masses, the clock shifts, the swings and the horizon are the reckoner's readings of the clicks (postulates 7 and 9). What is tested is emergence (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 18:1x UTC): the loader sets one setting, the calibre of numbers, the great clock, the sea of light and the first bobs, and from that setting alone everything runs, the wells, the Meshes' lengthening and shortening, the turns, the swings, the fittings on the Mesh, the bobs, the clicks; nothing is put in by hand after the load; that is the one trial of Universe24 and the nineteen gates are its reading.

The one run is the project's only main run (HIGHLIGHTS.md, The runs and the chart): Universe24's run of its declared ticks through `tools/eras.py` with its three logs, re-recorded whenever the engine changes under it, its pages drawn from the logs alone and its numbers in the folder's notes and in this document, never as a test's pin. The former worlds (the two slits, the big bang and the cycle, the atom, the clicks worlds, Bell and GHZ) stand as frozen records and run nothing (README.md, The former courses, by name).

## 2. What the run must show: the gates

The owner's words of 2026-10-25 (08:0x to 09:0x UTC, through the Boss; HIGHLIGHTS.md, the decision The chart's gates, approved 08:5x UTC): general relativity and the physics of reality must show in the clicks at the reckoner; the chart's gates are the nine phenomena, general relativity by name and the physics of reality, each a reading of the run's logs through the reckoner with no declaration in the loader, each SHOWN or NOT SHOWN by name on every chart. The gates' predicates and the chart's verdicts below are the agreed derivation of two blind hands (G1 and G2, compared cold by the Boss, 2026-10-25, #2187 comment 6392619280), every number their reading of the chart's three logs on c60804dc7; the predicates are an existence, a sign, an order or a monotonicity, never a typed number. "Board's" marks a gate that reads the whole great clock (the eras or the nodes log) and no inside observer; the others read the clicks (the proper, the position, the readings). The gates stand in code on this branch: `tools/record_gates.py` (`PYTHONPATH=src python tools/record_gates.py examples/events/universe24`, the folder positional), one function per gate, `gate_<name>(record)`, returning SHOWN or NOT SHOWN with its numbers, the great clock's view named, no typed threshold; and tests/test_the_record_gates.py asserting the SHOWN set and the NOT SHOWN set by name on the committed logs. Run on the chart of c60804dc7 the tool reads 13 of 23 verdicts SHOWN, the four gates with two verdicts counted twice (light's presence and its redshift; the horizon's Meshes and silence and its stopped clock; the conservation's identity and its exactness; the mass ratios' fit and their reading from the clicks), the same verdicts as the table below. The nineteen are the list the toy's chart is read against, filled by tools/record_gates.py's verdicts and never by hand, no gate dropped and none added without the owner's word; the fit to nature is as close as the integers allow (the mass ratios to 10^-7 at the 54-bit den) and never nature's precision, said plainly here. A verdict of this document changes only on the Boss's request, from a table or a log. Since 11:0x UTC (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 11:0x UTC, through the Boss, #2187 comment 6396810268, verbatim in translation: "everything you wrote that did not come out must enter the 19 gates; everything is to be seen there; so the order of the checks is one: you check on a Node, you check on the toy, and then it is to be seen in Universe24 too, so that in Universe24 there is no surprise that things do not happen"): everything not shown enters the gates, every item named NOT SHOWN or a finding against nature by name in the comparisons a gate of the table with its predicate and no note (the exact take, the bobs from born pairs, the collision, free fall, the horizon's stopped clock, the redshift of light, Coulomb's sign, the momentum across the click, the unspringing, the spinor's two beats and the split, the exclusion, the black body, the exponential decay, light on light, the x polarisation, the Casimir force, the running alpha, the neutron's three-fitted-hand list, the neutrino, and every other such line; the gates of the phenomena, the table below, 20 to 52 by the numbering of that day and Animate's rows since), and the order of the checks is one: the Node-clock, then the toy, then Universe24; every gate has its one-Node-clock test where one Node-clock can show it, then its reading on the toy's chart (the chiral emergence setting and the bobs' setting, over the cycles), and only then its reading on Universe24's chart, which confirms what the toy showed and names what it did not; David's reckoner reads the same gates(run) on both charts, and the Boss runs both. A derived gate is a prediction, and the chart must show it (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 11:0x UTC, through the Boss, #2187 comment 6396841814, verbatim in translation: "everything that was derived and is in the rest must happen when you check; no, there are things that are not on a Node, but those things have to be checked from outside, and they must come out in the universes; they are derived and you see them beforehand"): everything derived, the comparisons' sentences and their measured signatures, is written as a gate before the chart is run, blind, with its predicate, the numbers expected and the swing it may need; what one Node-clock can show is a one-Node-clock test, what one Node-clock cannot show (a bob's fall, a collision, the swings, the entropy's rise, the twist's 24 and 24) is read from outside by the reckoner over the chart's credit lines; and in the Universe runs every derived gate must come out. ### The reckoner's principles (the owner's words of 2026-10-25, 07:2x, 08:0x and 08:3x UTC; ALGEBRA.md, The Node-clock, the lines of that day)

- The reckoner reads only the Node-clock's clock and the position, with the readings the credit line carries (the point, the kind, the sense, the support, the beat, the identity, the momentum, the proper ticks), as an observer in nature does; it never reads the great clock's tick as an observer's quantity.
- The reckoner stands at a place: a detector Node-clock reading its own credits over its own clock and inferring the rest; two detectors share a clock only through a signal of one Mesh per tick.
- The reckoner keeps two views apart (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 18:0x UTC): the whole view, every click on the great clock, which nature does not have, the reader's table; and the one-place view, the owner's, where the reckoner finds what a bound bob is from the clicks alone (a Node-clock, or a set of Node-clocks within one Mesh, credited every period with its own beat) and reads that bob's clock, its proper ticks, everything of nature (the dilation, the redshift, the Meshes' lengthening) read from one bob's clock against another's; the chart's tables carry both views and the gates of general relativity are read in the second. The reckoner reads in integers (18:1x UTC): every reading a quotient with its remainder, a bit length or a count, never a float.
- The whole-great-clock log is the great clock's view, kept for the gates of the engine and the rewind, and no observer's: a reading made on the eras or the nodes log (the volume's notch U, the mean Mesh e^U, the horizon's Meshes, the Node-clocks turned) is a look beside the clicks and no measurement, and a gate that rests on it is marked great clock's below.
- All physics is in the reckoner (`tools/clicks_read.py` with `tools/look/captions.py`, nothing of it in `src/`): den's circle, the species and their names, the masses, the bobs and the wells are its readings over several Node-clocks and several ticks; what does not show in the clicks is not in the world.
- What the lattice conserves is shown conserved in the clicks (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 06:2x UTC GitHub's clock, through the Boss; ALGEBRA.md, The Node-clock, **The way to a solution**): a reading the gates carry, from the credit lines alone: the charge as the senses' sum over the fittings (gate 17), the count as taken equals credited (gate 15), the momentum as the credits' running cosine, the energy as the beat per proper tick before and after a click, the symmetry as the clicks' images under the 48; a solution that conserves on the great clock and not in the clicks is not shown. On this chart gates 15 and 17 carry it; the momentum, the energy and the 48 in the clicks are readings the reckoner is to land by the method (tools/record_gates.py), named here as the lack.

### The properties the engine shows, each with its test

The owner's word of 2026-10-25 (11:2x UTC, through the Boss, #2187 comment 6392645854): every property the Node-clock showed with the trains' trains keeps working under the generic Node-clock, the Meshes lengthening, the reversed clock, gravity and all the rest, each with a small test showing the property exists (an existence, a sign, an order or a monotonicity; no typed course number; under 15 seconds), the list written here as the gate of every stage of the generic Node-clock, the chart's gates of the table above beside it. The inventory is the agreed derivation of two blind hands (P1, 60 properties; P2, 46 at a coarser grain; compared cold by the Boss, #2187 comment 6392787098): every property the engine shows on main has a test asserting its existence except about ten, the same ten in both lists; 17 to 19 properties lean on the trains' trains and each has its re-posing for the generic Node-clock (the same statement read from the fixed gears or from the reckoner; the lean great clock's equality retiring into the count gate; the selector, den's circle and the bob's identity moving whole to the reckoner; the one sign train written by the Mesh's fitting the open derivation). The sixty lines below are the agreed inventory in the owner's order (the Boss's post of 2026-10-25, #2187 comment 6392886380; P2's eight groups head P1's finer lines), each with its test in the tree (file::function, mapped by the Scribe from the tests' docstrings for the Boss's cold read) or the test to land; a line that leans on the trains' trains carries its re-posing for the generic Node-clock in one clause (the hands' column: the same statement read from the fixed gears or from the reckoner). The ten tests named to land stand on this branch in tests/test_the_properties_hold_on_a_run.py (twelve functions on the bare 3-cube at den 1,021 under the hole setting, each an existence, a sign, an order or a monotonicity derived from the law's integers), beside the one-Node-clock toys (tests/test_the_generic_node_toy.py and tests/test_the_generic_node_toys_close_and_constants.py, seventeen tests of the Node-clock's acts and the owner's three constants at one Node-clock fed through its six Meshes, calibrated bit for bit against the great clock) and the chart's gates (tests/test_the_record_gates.py); the suite on the branch 123 functions in 45 files. Beside the list, the properties of nature the engine does not show stand by name in section 4 and in FURTHER_RESEARCH.md's first section.

The Meshes lengthening:

1. The Meshes lengthen as the load deepens: X rises under the light's drive, e^U rises above 1, the clock and the mesh rate fall (**The volume holder's rest is the clock's one notch**; **The rates compose**). tests/test_the_properties_hold_on_a_run.py::test_the_links_lengthen_on_the_running_board.
2. The lengthening is read in the clicks: the spacing of a Node-clock's credits is longer where e^U is larger (**The click's view: the readings on the credit line**; the gate 2). tests/test_the_properties_hold_on_a_run.py::test_the_lengthening_is_read_in_the_clicks; the chart's reading in tests/test_the_readers_tables.py::test_the_seven_tables_read_the_committed_record_through_the_command_line.

The reversed clock:

3. The turnover: a Node-clock at a weak maximum of its volume's time gear ends the tick with its notches exchanged and its remainders complemented, an involution; the floor turns the same way; the massless pair never turns (**The turnover**; **The floor**). tests/test_the_turn_at_the_floor.py::test_a_top_turns_every_node and ::test_the_floor_turns_as_the_top_does; tests/test_the_acts_table.py::test_the_fifth_act_the_swap_at_the_top_divides_nothing_and_is_its_own_inverse.
4. On the course a Node-clock turns at its own top; the light's velocity flips there; the rewind through the turn is exact (**The turnover**; **The inverse**). tests/test_the_properties_hold_on_a_run.py::test_the_clock_reverses_at_a_nodes_own_top_on_the_course.

## 5. The commands

The chart's run, the reckoner, the two pages and the rewind, from a checkout's root with the package installed (Python 3.14 or later; README.md, Run it):

```
PYTHONPATH=src nice -n 10 python tools/eras.py examples/events/universe24/universe24.json --every 100 --span 50 --out examples/events/universe24/universe24.eras.jsonl --clicks examples/events/universe24/universe24.clicks.jsonl --nodes examples/events/universe24/universe24.nodes.jsonl
PYTHONPATH=src python tools/clicks_read.py examples/events/universe24/universe24.clicks.jsonl --shape 5 5 5 --eras examples/events/universe24/universe24.eras.jsonl --nodes examples/events/universe24/universe24.nodes.jsonl --out examples/events/universe24/readings_clicks.json
PYTHONPATH=src python tools/look/eras_page.py examples/events/universe24/universe24.eras.jsonl --clicks examples/events/universe24/universe24.clicks.jsonl --nodes examples/events/universe24/universe24.nodes.jsonl --notes examples/events/universe24/notes.md --out examples/events/universe24/universe24.html
PYTHONPATH=src python tools/look/torus_page.py examples/events/universe24/universe24.nodes.jsonl --eras examples/events/universe24/universe24.eras.jsonl --clicks examples/events/universe24/universe24.clicks.jsonl --world examples/events/universe24/universe24.json --notes examples/events/universe24/notes.md --out examples/events/universe24/universe24.torus.html
PYTHONPATH=src python tools/back_in_time.py examples/events/universe24/universe24.json --from K --intervals N
PYTHONPATH=src python tools/node_integers.py examples/events/universe24/universe24.json --intervals 13 --bits 128
```

The clicks log is the chart; the eras and the nodes logs are looks beside it. The tests that touch the chart: tests/test_universe24_runs_its_cycle.py (the bare file loads; the small bare torus is seeded with the hole, swings and fittings its pairs), tests/test_the_readers_tables.py (the reckoner's tables by hand and the smoke check of the thirteen tables on the committed chart), tests/test_a_click_does_what_it_should.py (the owner's standing test of the click). The check before every landing: `PYTHONPATH=src python tools/check.py --base main`.
